narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved north across Cochise, Graham and Greenlee counties during the evening and overnight. Wind downed power poles and caused roof damage to homes in Tombstone. Flash flooding closed roads between Tombstone and Bisbee.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding and the closure of Route 80 northwest of Bisbee.

Heavy rain of 1.5 in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding and the closure of Davis Rd. east of Route 80 north of Bisbee. Flash flooding also occurred in Tombstone with the road washed out at the intersection of Ave. De La Loma & S. Laguna Ave.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLOOD REPORT FROM 6 NW BISBEE. SR 80 IS CLOSED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS NEAR BISBEE; CLOSURE DUE TO FLOODING AT MILEPOST 338.
